bad_trace.why: The spectrum routes (POST /api/spectrum/trace, POST /api/network/spectrum/tier_split) refused a power trace (empty, binary, too short or long, not numeric, time not in strictly increasing seconds, unevenly sampled, wrong or missing power unit), a band, limit or latency override they cannot use, or a network with no split storage. Nothing was changed; the message names the row or field. No chat tool calls these routes yet.
